It happens in the vast majority of police shootings, justified or not. It happens in war.

If you cannot train it out of the police, then what's the point?

We treat cops as if they are helpless victims of fear. They are supposed to be the trained experts.
#BlackLivesMatter

Do not let ANYONE tell you that a knife on the floorboard of a car is a threat to half a dozen armed cops.

They are supposed to be trained professionals. They should be held to a HIGHER standard than an average citizen, not given more leeway. 

#BlackLivesMatter 
#JacobBlake

Who is the head of #Antifa? And who is the head of #BlackLivesMatter Should we be watching for a perp-walk?

How can anyone believe anything these people say? How do people suspend all logical thinking?

This level of cognitive dissonance would put me in a catatonic fugue state.

Then add on top of that, life experiences & all of the stressors that human beings can be subjected to. 

So my totally unscientific, untested & basically made up theory is, that all African Americans have PTSD. 

If I'm wrong? Well, at worst, we get kinder.
#BlackLivesMatter

@realOsMos3 @llstudent08 I was afraid that this would happen.
First when I saw saw all of the white protesters at #BLM I thought great. Next I thought, could be a problem. People are often willing to hijack a cause for their own agenda (economic anxiety). Then I thought oh no, the race war coalition.
